name: Gulf Coast Energy and Freight Exercise
description: Manage hurricane, energy, port, rail, highway, and digital disruptions across a fictional Gulf Coast network.
commandIntent: Protect life-safety shipments, fuel distribution, port access, and inland freight while coastal conditions change.

assets.name: MV Bluebonnet
assets.route: Gulf approach → Bayline Ship Channel → Harbor Exchange
assets.alternateRoute: Offshore holding area → western channel → Harbor Exchange
assets.cargo: Containerized goods, food, machinery, and emergency supplies
assets.meaning: A cargo vessel depends on safe channel depth, navigation, pilots, and available terminal space.

assets.name: MedLift Gulf 5
assets.route: Coastal Air Cargo → Inland Response Hub
assets.alternateRoute: Coastal airspace → northern diversion → Inland Response Hub
assets.cargo: Medicine, repair parts, communications equipment, and laboratory supplies
assets.meaning: Air cargo protects urgent movement when roads or ports are constrained.

assets.name: Lone Star Freight 12
assets.alternateRoute: Northern rail bypass → Prairie Junction → Inland Response Hub
assets.cargo: Fuel components, grain, construction material, and recovery equipment
assets.meaning: Freight rail moves heavy cargo inland but depends on track, signal, bridge, and yard capacity.

assets.name: Gulf RoadLink 22
assets.route: Inland Response Hub → Energy Transfer Center → Coastal Air Cargo
assets.alternateRoute: Inland Response Hub → northern beltway → Coastal Air Cargo
assets.cargo: Generator fuel, groceries, water, medicine, and restoration equipment
assets.meaning: Trucks provide flexible final delivery but depend on drivers, fuel, road access, and safe operating windows.

approaching.title: Tropical system approaching
approaching.summary: A strengthening tropical system is moving toward the fictional coastal network.
approaching.wind: Tropical-storm-force winds possible within the exercise window
approaching.affectedArea: Ship channel, coastal terminals, airfield, and low-lying roads

assetEffects.reason: The vessel is slowing while port authorities establish the storm operating window.
The aircraft is operating with additional weather routing and ground-time limits.

warning.title: Hurricane warning active
warning.summary: Coastal operations have stopped while surge, wind, and flooding affect connected routes.
warning.wind: Damaging winds and dangerous coastal conditions
warning.affectedArea: Coastal port, energy terminals, rail approaches, and evacuation routes

assetEffects.reason: The ship channel is closed to inbound movement during dangerous conditions.
Urgent cargo is diverting to an inland airport outside the warning area.
Rail crews are inspecting low crossings and bridges before releasing trains.
The truck is staged outside flooded and evacuation-controlled roads.

clearing.title: System moving inland
clearing.summary: Coastal winds are decreasing, but inspections, debris, outages, and cargo backlogs remain.
clearing.wind: Winds decreasing; flooding remains in low areas
clearing.affectedArea: Damaged coastal routes and inland recovery corridors

assetEffects.reason: The vessel is waiting for channel and terminal inspections to finish.
The truck is using a verified recovery corridor around flooded roads.

ambientEvents.title: Localized coastal thunderstorm
ambientEvents.summary: Lightning and heavy rain have temporarily closed one ramp while nearby corridors remain usable.

effects.reason: The aircraft is using an inland arrival around a localized thunderstorm cell.

ambientEvents.title: Short-notice fuel price spike
ambientEvents.summary: A temporary wholesale price increase is forcing dispatchers to consolidate lower-priority deliveries.

effects.reason: The truck is delayed while loads are consolidated to control fuel cost.

ambientEvents.title: Rail yard switch assignment error
ambientEvents.summary: A human scheduling error placed priority cars in the wrong outbound block.

effects.reason: The train is using a secondary yard lead while priority cars are reassembled.

ambientEvents.title: Fraudulent cargo-release message
ambientEvents.summary: A criminal message is attempting to redirect a high-value load using copied carrier details.

effects.reason: The container release is held until the instruction is verified with the shipper.

ambientEvents.title: Tariff classification review
ambientEvents.summary: A recent tariff change has triggered a manual classification review for one shipment.

effects.reason: The cargo remains delayed while customs classification and tariff treatment are confirmed.

operatingConditions.title: Hurricane readiness activated
operatingConditions.summary: Partners have staged some supplies, but coastal operating windows are narrowing.

operatingConditions.title: Energy capacity already reduced
operatingConditions.summary: Planned maintenance has reduced available fuel-production and transfer capacity.

operatingConditions.title: Evacuation traffic increasing
operatingConditions.summary: Public movement and emergency activity are competing with normal freight on major roads.

operatingConditions.title: Interstate mutual aid staged
operatingConditions.summary: Utility crews, emergency logistics teams, and limited transport capacity are pre-positioned inland.
